cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: It Was Foreshadowed
cards.instruction: Turn the failure into a planned turning point by returning to earlier details that now appear to predict it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. The tent falling is our planned turning point. Remember the loose peg I mentioned?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You were supposed to fix it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then nobody would understand why it mattered later.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And the earlier remark about waterproof coats has become remarkably well placed.
